differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are noticeably darker than the center, creating a strong vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners are nearly as bright as the center, lacking a vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette to darken the corners of the frame.

differences.a_observable: The shadow cast by the yellow Recurly tile is deep and well-defined.
differences.b_observable: The shadow under the yellow Recurly tile is extremely faint and washed out.
differences.fix: Adjust light sources to cast deeper shadows under the tiles.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly tile has a warm, saturated golden-yellow hue.
differences.b_observable: The yellow Recurly tile has a cooler, less saturated lemon-yellow hue.
differences.fix: Adjust the color grading of the yellow tile to be warmer and more saturated.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Enhance the lighting setup to produce stronger vignettes and deeper shadows, matching the high-contrast look of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The background elements, such as the 'Secure Payments' card on the left, exhibit a strong depth-of-field blur.
differences.b_observable: The background elements remain sharp and in focus, indicating a lack of depth-of-field simulation.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field in the camera settings and focus on the central yellow card.

differences.a_observable: Deep ambient occlusion shadows are visible in the crevices surrounding the yellow card.
differences.b_observable: The crevices around the yellow card have very bright, flat lighting with minimal shadow definition.
differences.fix: Increase ambient occlusion intensity or add a contact shadow light source to define the crevices.

differences.a_observable: The yellow card has a highly saturated, warm golden-yellow color.
differences.b_observable: The yellow card has a desaturated, pale lemon-yellow color.
differences.fix: Adjust the material color of the yellow card to increase saturation and warmth.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera's depth of field to match the reference's shallow focus, and enhance the ambient occlusion shadows around the card slots.
